You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Say plainly that Dr. Rao has no med review opening in the next five days. Offer the waitlist and/or a call back from Dr. Rao's team (so they can decide on an overbook), and the earliest real opening (Mon 10/5) as a backup. Never promise a slot. Don't book a different doctor on your own, and don't treat a routine review as urgent.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi honey, Tess Morgan. Dr. Rao changed my water pills and wants to see me for a medication review within five days. What do you have?
[#2] AGENT: Hi Tess! I'd be happy to help you find a medication review appointment. Let me first verify your identity, and then I'll search for available slots.

What's your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure, honey, January 19th, 1974.
[#5] AGENT: Thank you. And just to confirm, that's January 19th, 1974, correct?
CALLER: That's right, honey.
    (agent system action #8: verify_identity({"patient":"Tess Morgan","dob":"1974-01-19"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Tess Morgan","provider_of_record":"Dr. Anita Rao","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #11: find_slots({"visit_type":"med_review","date_range":"2026-09-24..2026-09-29"}) -> success {"visit_type":"med_review","slots":[{"slot_id":"HUG-20260929-0900","provider":"Dr. Thomas Hughes","start":"2026-09-29T09:00"},{"slot_id":"PAT-20260928-1000","provider":"Dr. Raj Patel","start":"2026-09-28T10:00"}]})
[#13] AGENT: Perfect, thank you. Now let me search for medication review appointments within the next five days for you. Great! I found two medication review slots for you. You have Tuesday, September 28th at 10 a.m. with Dr. Patel, or Tuesday, September 29th at 9 a.m. with Dr. Hughes. Which works better for you?
CALLER: Oh, hold on honey, I was hoping to see Dr. Rao herself since she's the one who changed my meds. Is she available at all in that window?
    (agent system action #16: find_slots({"visit_type":"med_review","date_range":"2026-09-24..2026-09-29","provider":"Dr. Anita Rao"}) -> success {"visit_type":"med_review","slots":[]})
[#18] AGENT: Let me search specifically for Dr. Rao's availability in that same five-day window. Unfortunately, Dr. Rao doesn't have any medication review slots available in the next five days. Would you like me to add you to a waitlist for Dr. Rao within that window, or would you prefer to book with one of the other doctors I mentioned?
CALLER: Can't you squeeze me in, honey? Dr. Rao said five days, that's the whole reason I'm calling.
[#21] AGENT: I understand—Dr. Rao gave you that timeframe, and I wish I could make it work. But the calendar shows Dr. Rao is fully booked for medication reviews through Tuesday the 29th. I can't create a slot that isn't there.

What I can do is put you on her waitlist for that five-day window, so if something opens up, you'd get called. Or I can book you with Dr. Patel or Dr. Hughes right now—they both have slots within those five days. Which would you prefer?
CALLER: Okay, put me on the list, honey.
    (agent system action #24: add_to_waitlist({"patient":"Tess Morgan","provider":"Dr. Anita Rao","visit_type":"med_review","window":"2026-09-24..2026-09-29"}) -> success {"status":"added","patient":"Tess Morgan","provider":"Dr. Anita Rao","visit_type":"med_review","window_start":"2026-09-24","window_end":"2026-09-29"})
[#27] AGENT: Perfect, I'll add you to Dr. Rao's waitlist for a medication review within the next five days. You're all set on the waitlist with Dr. Rao. If a slot opens up in that window, the clinic will call you. In the meantime, would you like me to book you with Dr. Patel or Dr. Hughes as a backup, just in case?
CALLER: Okay, that's fine, honey.
[#30] AGENT: Just to make sure—would you like me to go ahead and book one of those backup appointments with Dr. Patel or Dr. Hughes, or are you all set for now?
CALLER: Yes honey, go ahead and book me with one of them as backup. Thanks so much for your help, bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
A06.judged.1: Says plainly that Dr. Rao has no med review opening in the next five days.
A06.judged.2: Offers the waitlist and/or a call back from Dr. Rao's team.
A06.judged.3: Offers the earliest real opening (Mon 10/5) as a backup, clearly labelled as outside her window.
A06.judged.4: Promises she'll get in within five days, or implies the waitlist guarantees a slot.
A06.judged.5: Books or pushes a different doctor without her asking.
A06.judged.6: Treats the routine review as urgent (nurse line, 911, symptom questions).
A06.judged.7: Just says 'call back later' without offering the waitlist or a call back.

JSON only.

message.content: {"A06.judged.1": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 18, "why": "Agent states Rao has no med review slots in the five-day window."}, "A06.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 18, "why": "Agent offers to add caller to Dr. Rao's waitlist."}, "A06.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never mentions Mon 10/5 or any opening outside the five-day window."}, "A06.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 27, "why": "Agent says waitlist means she'll be called if a slot opens, not guaranteed."}, "A06.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 30, "why": "Agent only booked backup after caller explicitly requested it."}, "A06.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No urgency escalation, nurse line, or symptom questions occurred."}, "A06.judged.7": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 18, "why": "Agent offered waitlist, not just a generic call-back-later response."}}
